evidence: The thickness and refractive index (R.I.) of AlN thin films were measured by spectroscopic ellipsometry (SE, M-2000DI, J.A. Woolam, Lincoln, NE, USA) and the values were fit using the spectra measured at 3 different angles (55°, 65°, and 75°). The chemical composition and bonding states of AlN thin films were characterized by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS). Surface roughness of AlN films was determined by atomic force microscope (AFM) (Veeco Multimode V. Non-contact AFM, Veeco, Plainview, NY, USA).
